mapper.sql: i.id, i.project_id, i.title, i.description, i.owner_id, u.user_name AS owner, i.due_at, i.priority, i.status, i.created_at, i.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM action_items i JOIN projects p ON p.id=i.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=i.owner_id WHERE i.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED' ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM action_items i JOIN projects p ON p.id=i.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=i.owner_id WHERE i.id=#{id} AND i.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.status<>'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE action_items SET title=COALESCE(#{title},title), description=COALESCE(#{description},description), owner_id=#{ownerId}, due_at=#{dueAt}, priority=COALESCE(#{priority},priority), status=COALESCE(#{status},status), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO action_items(project_id,title,description,owner_id,due_at,priority,status,created_by) SELECT #{projectId},#{title},#{description},#{ownerId},#{dueAt},#{priority},#{status},#{createdBy} WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND wm.user_id=#{createdBy} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
